title: UI风格#192 - Woodtype Industrial (木版工业)
description: 创建第192种UI风格：木版工业风格 - 复古木活字、工业质感、金属与木材。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGJ.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Woodtype Industrial style When color palette Then features wood brown, rust orange, industrial black
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#8B4513 (木棕), #B7410E (铁锈橙), #1A1A1A (工业黑), #D2691E (巧克力), #A0522D (赭石)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Woodtype Industrial style When typography Then uses woodtype: American Typewriter, Courier, Rockwell
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：American Typewriter (木版), Courier (等宽), Rockwell (粗衬线)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Woodtype Industrial style When layout Then woodblock print, industrial machinery, factory floor
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：木版印刷、工业机械、工厂地板

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Woodtype Industrial style When UI elements Then wood grain, metal rust, letterpress texture
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：木纹质感、金属锈迹、活字纹理

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Woodtype Industrial UI When functional Then includes press chat, factory agents, industrial stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：印刷聊天、工厂代理、工业统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Woodtype Industrial UI When copy Then uses industrial: 'Press', 'Forge', 'Foundry', 'Stamp'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'PRESS. FORGE. FOUNDRY.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'STAMP'、'DEPLOY'→'FORGE'
